parsed_response.narration: You stand at Cinderwatch's eastern gate. Rain spatters soot-dark stone; frayed banners hang above Cinderwatch's eastern gate. Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in. A tavern runner shouts offers of hot stew and paid rumor. A notice board lists new taxes, curfews, and a posted warning about a missing patrol. You can read the notice board, approach the tavern runner, or watch the crowd.
